verdict.rationale: Circle offers event-driven building blocks rather than a rules engine. Webhooks send HTTP POSTs when a resource changes state so your own application can react [circle-docs-10]. CCTP can trigger automated actions on the destination chain after assets arrive [circle-docs-5]. Agent wallets and Gas Station enforce policies you define [circle-docs-19][circle-docs-2], but these are guardrails rather than event-triggered actions. Missing for 10: a native user-defined rule/automation engine (if-event-then-action configuration), docs on configuring CCTP hooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
